localChanges: When one of your units attacks and loses, only that unit is destroyed now. The units it shared a tile with survive. A stack outside a city is still wiped out when its defender loses (closes #371).

log: `Attack` processes `Defeated` for a losing attacker as well as a defeated defender, passing itself as the third argument. `civ1-unit:unit/defeated/destroy-stack` now only applies when the defeated unit is not the action's unit, so a defeated attacker dies alone. Calls without an action keep the defender behaviour (civ-clone/web-renderer#371).
